warnings: CAMELYON17 uses the supplied center-held-out test split and slide-level 4-class labels, not official challenge patient-level staging.
The existing slide-level validation split shares 27 patients with training. Validation is not patient-independent; the baseline retains the existing split for reproducibility.

training_extension.sampling: Uniform without replacement; max(1, floor(N * keep_fraction)).
training_extension.mask_rng: Dedicated CPU torch.Generator seeded with training_seed.
training_extension.evaluation: Full bags; no patch masking or consistency loss.
